scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw simulation snapshots is infeasible in the checker sandbox; result-level compare against paper-reported gold with generous tolerances is acceptable. Absorption peaks are recomputed from the agent's CSV (spectral peak detection) and compared to paper reference positions.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold formation energies, barriers, and absorption peak positions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 1 (formation energies), Fig. 3 (barriers), Figs. 4-5 and text (absorption peaks)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the peer-reviewed paper; tolerances set to account for toolchain differences (VASP vs Quantum Espresso/Yambo)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are published experimental/computational results; used as reference with physically motivated tolerances. No invented labels or arbitrary data.

outputs.description: Formation energies of the hydrogen-induced defects silanol and Si-OOH+Si-H.
Energy barriers for O-O and Si-O bond cleavage reactions.
Optical absorption spectra for all three defect configurations.

output_contract.notes: Scored values and spectral peak positions are compared to hidden gold reference values within tolerances that account for methodological differences. The agent must produce the artifacts by genuinely executing the computational pipeline; no data or pre-computed models are provided.
